cross_checked_atoms.claim: The first verified accessible-Git installable scripts/stern.py boundary at b0be33fb6b223cd0a34f0fabc00b71dc57c5cb6a already contains the Phase-2 nonblocking zulassen/PostTool completion semantics. It is a shipping/source-availability boundary, not evidence of the mechanism's creation time.

Repository history contains a documented live-host-to-repo mirror gap around commit 4901b894249c93e766bab946edfd7b37c01f71f3; intermediate semantic introductions cannot be dated exactly from repository commits alone.

The F94 wegehierarchie implementation bytes are recoverable at DEV_SOURCE_RESEARCH/repository/scripts/udb/abruf/_archiv-phase4/wegehierarchie.py, but live paket.py imports .wegehierarchie and the pinned repository has no active root-module Git history. Source recovery is resolved; executable package closure is not.

Exact archived wache-koenig source is a genuine Bash-scoped pre-execution blocker when registered: non-Bash tools are allowed immediately, selected destructive Bash commands are denied or require a one-shot ticket. Exact scheduler registration/order and current runtime reachability remain unproven.

The historical freigabe + command-hash ticket path preserves a useful separation: model/tool request does not self-authorize; a human TTY path creates a delayed, expiring, one-shot grant. The successor must replace raw command-text binding and behavioral typing heuristics with typed authenticated capability/effect identity.

Realtime call_id is retained while queued and is returned to the Realtime API as function_call_output, but _tool_ausfuehren passes only parsed arguments into local action helpers. frank_auftrag_stellen ultimately creates a fresh background auftrag_id and claude_frage creates/resumes a separate Claude session; the upstream Realtime call_id is not propagated as immutable parent identity into those child execution paths.
cross_checked_atoms.evidence_boundary: Direct source finding only; no concurrent/live effect race or host permission path was executed in this Triggerword-5 run.

effect_identity_chain: Do not reuse one identifier across abstraction layers. Preserve VoiceFunctionInvocation.realtime_call_id as immutable parent identity.
Bind any confirmed ActionCandidate/PendingEffect to that parent plus response_id, generation, causal_event_id and canonical request_digest.
When an asynchronous Claude/background child is created, mint child_task_id and preserve parent_realtime_call_id; each downstream Claude tool_use_id remains its own child invocation identity.

EffectRequest -> EffectDecision/CapabilityLease -> SubmissionReceipt -> ExecutionReceipt -> WorldEffectVerification -> ResultReentry -> CompletionEvidence must bind the correct child invocation and parent lineage.
Session identity is context, not effect identity; successful PostToolUse cannot retroactively create admission authority.
voice_confirmation_boundary: The two-step frank_auftrag_stellen confirmation gate is useful pre-admission evidence because it requires a later server-transcribed utterance and rejects explicit contradiction keywords.

It is not authenticated speaker identity, not canonical EffectGate authority, and it covers only that tool path; frank_erinnerung_schreiben and other state-changing paths require the same deterministic effect boundary.
Barge-in/non-completed-response cancellation remains valid only before dispatch/submission; after external submission ambiguity is OUTCOME_UNKNOWN until verified.
historical_gate_migration: Keep the historical one-shot grant properties: out-of-model separation, exact scope, expiry and single-use consumption.
Replace regex/raw-command authority with typed intent/resource/capability semantics bound to request digest, generation, policy version and executor identity.

Historical Bash-only coverage cannot be promoted to whole-effect authority; Write/Edit/NotebookEdit/database/network and other state-changing classes must converge on one deterministic successor boundary.
donor_closure: Do not blindly copy archived wegehierarchie bytes into the active namespace.
Triggerword 4 must explicitly adapt or retire F94 and prove the chosen successor with a source-bound regression where carried-walk success cannot silently degrade on missing dependency.

preserved_contradictions.statement: Accessible Git proves a first shipped source boundary but not exact Phase-2 creation chronology.
Exact historical gate source is recovered, but scheduler registration/order and current runtime reachability are not.
Historical wache-koenig is Bash-only and cannot establish complete effect coverage.
Exact archived F94 source exists, but the current live import target remains unclosed in repository source.
Realtime call identity is not carried into background/Claude child execution identity; end-to-end effect lineage therefore needs an explicit parent-child contract.

triggerword4_acceptance_handoff: A confirmed voice action preserves immutable parent Realtime call identity through candidate creation and every child task/tool invocation without treating session_id as effect identity.
Parallel/reordered child tool completions cannot cross-assign EffectDecision or outcome to another parent/child invocation.
A one-shot typed EffectDecision cannot be reused after consumption, after expiry, with a different request_digest, generation, resource/capability scope, policy version or executor identity.
Barge-in before dispatch yields CANCELLED_PRE_DISPATCH and zero effect; cancellation after submission cannot mint success/cancelled and remains OUTCOME_UNKNOWN until verified.
Non-Bash state-changing tools traverse the same deterministic successor EffectGate rather than relying on historical Bash regex coverage.
The selected wegehierarchie/F94 successor has exact source closure and fails loudly or explicitly retires the feature; missing dependency cannot silently remove reinforcement.
next_exact_gate: Recover exact current/historical scheduler registration for the blocking watcher or its successor, then trace non-Bash voice/background child effects through the actual host executor boundary using immutable parent-child invocation identity; Triggerword 4 should implement these as typed regressions before donor freeze.
